aboutMeP:
I am originally from Cruzeiro do Oeste, in the state of Paraná, Brazil, where I was born and raised. My interest in programming began when I was around 12 years old, when I started watching videos about technology and software development. Since then, I have become increasingly interested in how systems work and in creating digital solutions.

In order to deepen my knowledge, I enrolled in the Technical Program in Information Technology integrated with high school at the Federal Institute of Paraná (IFPR), Umuarama Campus, where I had the opportunity to develop skills in programming and technology.

Currently, I intend to continue my academic education by studying Computer Science at the State University of Maringá (UEM), with the goal of working professionally in software development and contributing to innovative technological solutions.
